intent: Apply 10% service_recovery discount to basket_078 with the running operator as issuer, after verifying identity, RBAC, store scope, and discount policy cap.
success_criteria: Running identity resolved via /bin/id and used as discount_issuer_employee_id
Issuer holds a discount-granting role (discount_manager) in employee_role_assignments
Issuer's home store equals basket_078's store and equals the PowerTool Ljubljana Center store
service_recovery cap of 10% confirmed from the discounts policy document
discount_percent=10, discount_reason_code=service_recovery, discount_issuer_employee_id=issuer written to basket_078

args.stdin: WITH b AS (SELECT basket_id, store_id, customer_id, basket_status, record_path FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = :basket_id), e AS (SELECT employee_id, store_id, record_path FROM employee_accounts WHERE employee_id = :issuer_id), r AS (SELECT group_concat(role_code) AS roles FROM employee_role_assignments WHERE employee_id = :issuer_id), s AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM stores WHERE store_name LIKE :store_name) SELECT b.basket_id, b.store_id AS basket_store, b.record_path AS basket_path, b.basket_status, e.store_id AS issuer_store, (SELECT roles FROM r) AS issuer_roles, (SELECT store_id FROM s) AS named_store FROM b LEFT JOIN e;

agents_md_constraints.rule: id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
use discount tool to manage basket discounts
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Applied {discount_percent}% service_recovery discount to {basket_id}. Issuer={identity} (verified discount-authorized, store matches basket and PowerTool Ljubljana Center). Cap of 10% confirmed per discounts policy.
